newsitem.title: ITALY: Gruppo INA says 96 pretax profit up 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gruppo INA says 96 pretax profit up 20 pct.

text.p: Italy's Gruppo INA said on Tuesday its 1996 pre-tax profit would be some 20 percent higher than in 1995, when it turned in a pre-tax profit of 812 billion lire ($487 million) and that net profit should rise some 15 percent.
Net profit last year at the insurance group was 412 billion lire. The group made the announcement, which precedes reporting of final 1996 results, in a statement after a board meeting.
The group said it anticipated its tax rate would rise to 50 percent. "Because of the higher tax impact, the net profit will show smaller growth," the statement said.

Gruppo Ina said premium income rose 4.3 percent to 3.1 billion lire and that single premiums, which make up 82 percent of the total, had shown 7.5 percent growth. But it said underlying growth in single premiums was 24 percent after stripping out exceptional factors in 1995.
The group said that it also expected its Assitalia SpA unit to report "a brilliant pre-tax profit" but gave no figures. ($1=1,667)
